title: Effect
description: Effect descriptor — payload of a Block whose role is to describe a side effect. Per spec.md §5.7. Effect is a CLASSIFICATION over Block payloads, not a separate core type.

oneOf.title: Class A — pure local
oneOf.description: Operates on the View's Delta layer. Reversed by Delta discard at abort. Does NOT enter View.effects_hash.

oneOf.title: Class B — idempotent remote
oneOf.description: Carries a version reference for commit-time precondition check. Idempotent under the version_ref: same ref ⇒ same observable consequence.

version_ref.description: Version reference to assert at commit time. Mismatch ⇒ E-002 CommitConflict.

compensable_cost.description: Optional adapter-layer refinement (per Atomix arXiv 2602.14849 reversible-with-cost). Not part of protocol surface.

oneOf.title: Class C — irreversible remote
oneOf.description: Cannot be undone by reel. Buffered in View.effects_hash; fires at commit after all Class B effects (ADR-0015).

op.description: Adapter-defined operation descriptor. The commit UI MUST display this to the user before firing (per §8.3).

x-reel-status: v0.1 canonical (per ADR-0025). Note: idempotency_key field renamed to version_ref to reflect ADR-0024 + ADR-0025 semantics (precondition check, not uniqueness).
